column6: Legend is defined by contrast with myth (its questions ask what separates legend from myth).
Legend is one oral narrative genre within folklore.
Myth is framed as a narrative form distinct from history and fiction; genre awareness helps.
Myths are described as symbolic narratives working on a metaphorical level.
Sides of shapes are the first segments students meet.
Segments are drawn with rulers and defined by having a definite length.
The multiplication principle counts pairs, i.e. |A x B| = |A||B|.
The m x n array model of multiplication is the concrete base of the principle.
Course-opening survey; it introduces the material rather than drawing on prior topics.
Algebra 2 introduction to matrices as arrays precedes the formal linear-algebra definition.
R^n vectors generalize 2D vectors.
Foundational entry point for proof courses; no earlier set topic exists in the graph.

Entry point of formal logic; defines what a statement is.
3D coordinates explicitly extend the 2D coordinate plane by a third axis.
Earlier work with categorical data grounds the distinction.
Measurement data on line plots is the earlier encounter with quantitative data.
Chi-square is defined as the sum of squared independent standard normals.
Chi-square is a continuous distribution described by a density.
Core idea states E and Var of chi-square(k).
Events are defined as subsets of the sample space.
Prealgebra probability with coins and dice precedes formal sample spaces.

Scatterplots apply to two quantitative variables.

Order axioms formalize familiar rules for manipulating inequalities.
Real-analysis use of the axioms is deriving consequences by proof.

Doubling rules are justified by avoiding parallel octaves.
Close vs open triad spacing precedes SATB spacing rules.
Method centres on reading primary sources and their survival biases.
General historical method underlies music-history method.
Overview presumes the idea of studying change over time from evidence.
Ubuntu is framed as a communal alternative to Western individualism.
Ubuntu offers an alternative ethics of personhood and obligation.
Agamben explicitly builds on Foucault's biopolitics.
Bare life is a theory of sovereign power; classical sovereignty is the backdrop.
Arendt's labor/work/action scheme is set against Marx's privileging of labor.
Overview treats Confucianism philosophically; historical introduction helps.
Overview treats Taoism philosophically; historical introduction helps.
Badiou is positioned against postmodern skepticism about truth.
Field is defined as applying phenomenological method to religion.
Field applies hermeneutic interpretation to religious experience.
Butler's performativity adapts Austin's performative utterances.
Beauvoir's Second Sex claim that one becomes a woman is the classic precursor.
Butler draws on Foucault's account of norms and discursive power.
Latin American philosophy centres colonialism, epistemicide and Eurocentrism critique.

Ethics as prior to ontology is a direct reply to Heidegger.
Nancy radicalizes Heidegger's being-with (Mitsein) and critique of presence.
Topic applies phenomenological method to racialized experience.
Fanon-style analysis of the lived racialized body extends Merleau-Ponty's embodiment.
Basic moral judgement precedes asking what makes actions good.
The lie-to-save-a-life case is the same intuition pump used here.
Ordinary moral judgement is what the normative/metaethical split sorts.
Rules as standards we should follow are the concrete form of normativity.
Obligatory/forbidden builds on basic right and wrong.

Earlier paradox puzzles prepare the sorites.
